index.description: AI-gile is ċeartbord for AI-forgewrītena weorodu. Hīe wyrċaþ þonne þū slǣpst; þū hæfst ānne scortne hēap tō ġeċēosenne, tō costienne and tō onfōnne.
hero.alphaTitle: Ǣrlīċ and unġeendod: þancas þæt þū hit costast!
hero.lede: Hīe timbriaþ þonne þū slǣpst. Þū onwæcnast tō ānum scortum hēape: sume ācsunga, sume dǣda tō costienne, ān oþþe twā purpuran ġimmas. Clyppa, onfōh, and eft tō þīnum drence.

f.pile.html: For þē hielt eall þæt þē bīdaþ, ofer ǣlc weorc: ācsunga, þing tō costienne, weorc þe man ānīg dōn mæġ. Þīn ġerang segþ hwæt nēhst is and hū lang hit nimþ.
f.sleep.h: Weorodu þe wyrċaþ þonne þū slǣpst
f.sleep.p: Ǣlc weorc hæfþ ealdormann and weorod AI-sendan. Āwrīt word on ċearte and þæt weorod onwæcnaþ, dēþ þæt weorc, and bringþ hit eft mid stæpum þe wērig mann folgian mæġ.
f.tester.p: Ǣr þon þe ǣnig þing tō þē cymþ, folgaþ costere þǣm stæpum on onlīcnesse þæs forgewrites and æteawaþ hwæt hē ġeseah, mid sċērmmynde. Bēhwyrf þā forþfarenan and onfōh mid ānum clyppe.
f.proof.p: Ǣlc ofergifu æteawaþ hwæt wende: þā ġewritu, þone unġelīcnesse, þā sċērmmyndu. Nā þearft þū ǣlc forgewrit openian tō sēonne ġif hit gedōn is.
f.chat.p: Discord-lic sīdstrang: ān tācen for ǣlc weorc, purpuran ġimmas for þǣm þe þē þearf. Send ealdormenn ġeþōht; hē wyrcþ hit tō ċeartum and tō ġeþeahte, mid ✅ Fōr-cnappe.
f.tidy.p: Ġesibbe ċearte weorþaþ tō ānum, ġemenġede naman bēoþ ġerihte, and tācnes ġeseah hielt þone code smæl. Læsse tō wendenne, læsse tō þencenne.
f.private.li1: Þæt bord rint on þīnum āgenum tōle and andswarap ānum þē.
f.private.li2: Dīgole ġewrit betwux mannum bēoþ fram ende tō ende ġehŷdde.
f.private.li3: Nān ġerecen, nān fyligend, nān cȳcelċe.
f.lang.p: Ofer 120 spræċa, fram Dyċe, Wēalisċre and Iēpānisċre tō wīċinge, Yoda and Klingon, mid fæstum wendunge eft tō Englisċ for þā cræftword.
f.service.p: Timbrodest þū þing mid searocræfte þe menn nū brūcaþ? Mearca hit swā þēnunge and þæt bord fultumaþ þē hit wel tō healdenne: ġeþeounge costunga, openlīc stæðlīnes-folio, ġelimpu mid æftersmeagunge, wendinga þe Fēr behōfiaþ, hordcopian dæġhwāmlīce ġecostode. Fultum lǣreþ ǣlcne stæpe þā hwīle þū gǣst.

msgr.p2: Tō gemæcenne, scēawa QR-tācn on þīnum borde. Forma sīþ? Frēondlic fandungspell ġewissaþ þē ymbūtan.
